turns.assessment: The degradation is confined to lightpath och121: its S05 receiver shows lower OSNR and higher pre-FEC BER, while the channel power arriving from S09 falls substantially. The same channel is normal on arrival at S09 from S12, and the S09→S05 amplifier telemetry shows no gain, output-power, or pump-current change. This localizes the fault to channel-specific attenuation by the S09 ROADM as och121 is sent toward S05.

proposals.rationale: A one-channel WSS attenuation drift at S09 directly explains the 5.71-level channel-power reduction at the S05 monitor and the resulting OSNR/BER degradation at trx.och121.z. Unchanged incoming monitoring at S09 and unchanged S09→S05 amplifier telemetry exclude the preceding route and strongly disfavor a line-wide fault.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

proposals.rationale: Band-dependent gain tilt could reduce one channel without a large total-power change, but none of the amplifiers on S09→S05 reported a change, making this substantially less likely than channel-specific WSS attenuation.
proposals.note: nothing at that location documents the mode

clarify.assessment: The evidence localizes the attenuation to S09, between the unchanged incoming observation from S12 and the reduced channel power received at S05. It does not distinguish whether the drifting WSS attenuation is associated with the S12-facing channel location [0] or the S05-facing channel location [1], since either can reduce only this channel after the S09 ingress monitor.

llm_alone.decision: commit not to one place (2 locations); reported as a set
